title: Auto Loans: Ending an Autopay Enrollment
content:
A borrower may end the autopay arrangement on an Auto Loans account at Piedmont Crescent Bank. This page describes what the cancellation records, when the new rate takes effect, and the customer-run action that carries it out.

## Scope and effect on the rate

The policy applies when a borrower ends the autopay enrollment standing on one of their auto loans. The APR written on the cancellation is not estimated; it is worked out afresh from the discounts that stay with the loan once autopay stops. It is the rate the loan carries from the moment of cancellation onward: it is recorded together with the cancellation and applies from then, not from some later installment.

## Continuity of autopay

A change of due day that the borrower has asked for counts as under way from the moment it is requested until the moment it is recorded on the loan. Where the borrower is switching the account that pays by autopay over to another of their checking accounts, the loan keeps a standing enrollment for as long as any such change of due day is under way.

## What the loan shows afterwards

Once the cancellation has run, autopay no longer appears on the loan and no paying account is named for it. The loan carries whatever APR and discount list were given in the call, and the borrower's instruction is kept on file as a completed autopay change request. No payment is taken.

## Invoking the action

The action is `cancel_autopay_a2c51ad3`. It belongs to the borrower: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, since ending autopay is the borrower's own instruction.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | the loan whose enrollment ends, from the auto loan lookup | identifier |
| `autopay_source_account_id` | the checking account the ending enrollment was drawing on, as shown as the autopay paying account in the auto loan lookup | identifier |
| `interest_rate` | the APR after cancellation | percent with two decimals, for example 7.24 for 7.24 percent |
| `rate_discounts` | the discounts still included in the APR after cancellation | one of the enum values below |

Values of `rate_discounts`: `none` (no discount remains), `autopay` (only the autopay discount remains), `relationship` (only the checking relationship discount remains), `autopay_and_relationship` (both remain).

## Receipt

A cancellation that went through reports status "autopay_cancelled". Alongside it come `request_id`, which identifies the filed autopay change request, `auto_loan_id`, `cancelled_source_account_id`, naming the account the arrangement used to draw on, `autopay_enrolled` reading false, and the `interest_rate` and `rate_discounts` now on the loan.
